description: Multi-step warehouse-native pipeline compiled to one CTE-CTAS plan per sink. YAML-defined stored-procedure shape.

inputs.description: Upstream table(s) referenced by name in each step — no data passed

outputs.description: One or more materialized tables (one per sink), referenceable by name — no data passed

source.label: Source
source.description: Flat shape (one source, one ops chain, one sink): {upstream_table: 'schema.table'} or {kind: table|sql, ...}. Use 'steps' for multi-source.

operations.label: Operations
operations.description: Flat shape: ordered ops applied to 'source'. Supported ops: filter, with_columns, select, drop, group_by, sort, limit, top_n, top_n_per_group, dedup, distinct, union, join, sql.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Multi-step form. Each step: {id, source: {kind: table|ref|sql, ...}, operations: [...]}. Use 'ref' to consume an earlier step. Use 'op: sql' for raw-SQL escape (supports <<self>> and <<step_id>> placeholders).

sinks.label: Sinks
sinks.description: Multi-step form. Each sink: {from: <step_id>, table: 'schema.table', mode: replace|create_if_not_exists}.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.

automation_condition.label: Automation Condition
automation_condition.description: Jinja-templated AutomationCondition factory, e.g. "{{ dg.AutomationCondition.eager() }}". Dagster's component YAML loader resolves it to the actual AutomationCondition object at load time.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (sample rows) for builder UIs.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when `include_preview_metadata` is True.

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

return_dataframe.label: Return Dataframe
return_dataframe.description: When true, after running the CTAS the asset SELECTs from the primary sink table and returns the result as a pandas DataFrame so downstream pandas-consuming assets can read it via Dagster's IO manager. the boundary where data leaves the warehouse and lands in memory. Leave false (default) for pure SQL chains that end at a final warehouse table; flip on when this is the bridge step between warehouse-side SQL and downstream pandas work.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run -- the partition_key token threaded through this pipeline's step templating becomes a comma-joined string spanning the whole range. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition. Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set. 'single_run' requires a partition-range-aware IO manager (e.g. a DB-table IO manager with partition_expr set) -- a generic filesystem/default IO manager cannot persist a single_run output spanning multiple partitions and will raise a clear error at materialization time.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).
